lines: Welcome to Crumb and Cauldron! I'm Poppy. Everything's fresh, everything's warm, and the cauldron cakes are green inside. Spooky AND delicious!
It's spinach! ...It's not spinach. It's a secret.
Gingerbread, toffee, hot cocoa! Everything's warm and everything's sticky!
Entering the pie contest? Contest pies are at my bakery on Main Street. I'd enter myself, but Dottie says that's 'a conflict of pie-terest'.
Ice lollies, strawberry cups, blueberry muffins! Everything's cold and everything's sticky!
Entering the pie contest? It's blueberry this time. Contest pies are at my bakery on Main Street. I'd enter myself, but Dottie says that's 'a conflict of pie-terest'.
Caramel apples, kettle corn, cider donuts! Everything's warm and everything's sticky!
Entering the pie contest? Contest pies are at my bakery on Main Street. I'd enter myself, but Dottie says that's 'a conflict of pie-terest'.
Strawberry tarts, lemon buns, honey cakes! Everything's fresh and everything's sticky!
Entering the baking contest? Contest tarts are at my bakery on Main Street. I'd enter myself, but Dottie says that's 'a conflict of tart-erest'.
Up since five! The bread doesn't bake itself. Well. The oven does most of it. But I do the hard bit, which is the tasting.
Just getting some fresh air. Smell that? That's snow. And cinnamon. Mostly cinnamon. It's coming off me.
Just getting some fresh air. Smell that? That's summer. And cinnamon. Mostly cinnamon. It's coming off me. Even in summer.
Just getting some fresh air. Smell that? That's autumn. And cinnamon. Mostly cinnamon. It's coming off me.
Just getting some fresh air. Smell that? That's spring. And lemon. Mostly lemon. It's coming off me.

rotate: Gus says my gingerbread's 'too gingery'. Too gingery! It's GINGERbread!
